viewpoint: Directions are relative to this board; square pad is pin 1.

pins.meaning: TRS tip: pedal wiper INPUT or excitation OUTPUT, selected by JP301.
pins.connect: Passive expression socket tip; not a powered CV pedal.

pins.meaning: TRS ring: excitation OUTPUT or pedal wiper INPUT, selected by JP301.
pins.connect: Passive expression socket ring; not a powered CV pedal.

pins.meaning: Common 0 V return; not a signal or positive supply.
pins.connect: TRS sleeve; pedal pot ground and enclosure bond.

pins.meaning: Feed regulated 3V3 into the module. This pin does not supply power.
pins.connect: Positive output of the matching regulated supply.

pins.meaning: Common 0 V return; not a signal or positive supply.
pins.connect: Host or cable ground / 0 V.

pins.meaning: I2C SDA data travels both ways; 3.3 V bus only.
pins.connect: Host I2C SDA data pin.

pins.meaning: I2C clock comes from the host into this module.
pins.connect: Host I2C SCL clock pin.

JP301.title: JUMPER ONLY: PEDAL POLARITY

pins.meaning: Tip contact side of polarity selector.
pins.connect: Fit a shunt to pin 3 for tip-wiper mode.

pins.meaning: Ring contact side of polarity selector.
pins.connect: Fit a shunt to pin 4 for tip-wiper mode.

pins.meaning: Pedal wiper signal enters the ADC circuit.
pins.connect: Shunt 1-3 for tip wiper, or 3-5 for ring wiper.

pins.meaning: Current-limited excitation goes out to the passive pedal.
pins.connect: Shunt 2-4 for tip wiper, or 4-6 for ring wiper.

pins.meaning: Ring contact side of polarity selector.
pins.connect: Fit a shunt to pin 3 for ring-wiper mode.

pins.meaning: Tip contact side of polarity selector.
pins.connect: Fit a shunt to pin 4 for ring-wiper mode.

JP301.setup: TIP: 1-3 + 2-4; RING: 3-5 + 4-6. Use TWO shunts; no external cable.

JP302.title: JUMPER ONLY: ADC ADDRESS

pins.meaning: Ground/LOW address selection terminal.
pins.connect: Shunt 1-2 selects address 0x48.

pins.meaning: ADC address selection input; do not leave floating.
pins.connect: Fit ONE shunt: 1-2 or 2-3.

pins.meaning: 3.3 V/HIGH address selection terminal, not a power connector.
pins.connect: Shunt 2-3 selects address 0x49.

JP302.setup: 1-2: 0x48; 2-3: 0x49. One shunt required; no external cable.

JP303.title: JUMPER ONLY: SDA PULLUP

pins.meaning: 3.3 V through the local 2.2k pull-up resistor.
pins.connect: Shunt 1-2 only if the host has no SDA pull-up.

pins.meaning: SDA data side of the pull-up jumper.
pins.connect: Same shunt; this is not a host cable connector.

JP303.setup: Fit 1-2 to enable. Remove if host already has a pull-up.

JP304.title: JUMPER ONLY: SCL PULLUP

pins.meaning: 3.3 V through the local 2.2k pull-up resistor.
pins.connect: Shunt 1-2 only if the host has no SCL pull-up.

pins.meaning: SCL clock side of the pull-up jumper.
pins.connect: Same shunt; this is not a host cable connector.

JP304.setup: Fit 1-2 to enable. Remove if host already has a pull-up.

mounting_holes: H1/H2 are M2 mounting holes, not electrical connections. Small vias are not user connectors.
